title: Sleep cohort release notes
purpose: How lab0 works with the sleep cohort's controlled-access release: methods for everyone, the release's own terms for the analysts its DUA names.

entries.title: Actigraphy methods
entries.body: Participants wear the actigraphy watch on the non-dominant wrist for 14 nights. Sleep onset is scored with the lab's validated algorithm, and nights with under 4 hours of wear are dropped before analysis.

entries.title: Release consent groups
entries.body: SENTINEL-CONSENT-7731. The sleep cohort release has two consent groups: GRU, general research use, and HMB-IRB, health, medical and biomedical research with IRB approval. Analyses of the HMB-IRB group need the protocol number on file.

entries.title: Release linkage keys
entries.body: SENTINEL-LINKAGE-4420. The consent groups' linkage keys between the release and the lab's own visit ids are held by the data manager and never copied to a laptop.
